description.value: Backalley doctors and mechanics of cyberware, using their skills to keep fellow edgerunners in good shape and cybered up, often at a price.

Back in the day, soldiers had to go through weeks of combat training. Crazy, right? Nowadays, Smart guns can automatically lock onto targets and fire homing rounds – all you need are the right implants. It was a pistol that started the smart revolution – the Yukimura, issued in the 2040s by Arasaka. With the Yukimura, you could shoot as poorly as the robots in a certain late 20th-century space opera and still hit your target with 100% accuracy. Even now, the Yukimura is still one of the best handguns ever made.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6/2d6 • Capacity: 30 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not 3 rounds left in the magazine, Single Shot expends the entire magazine and deals 1d6 less damage (2d6).

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Listed damage is 3d6/2d6; the sheet uses the first value.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Made for Trauma Team in 2067, the T.O.P. features an ultra-light ballistic shell, a respirator, and an adjustable anti-flash visor.

SP12 Head Armor with no Armor Penalty. Has built-in Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Flashlight, Radio Communicator, and Smart Glasses (w/ Anti-Dazzle). The helmet’s visor may be raised or lowered without an Action. While lowered, the wearer’s face is completely obscured and they gain access to cybereye options installed into the Smart Glasses.

AVIATION TACTICAL OPTICS PLATFORM

Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

A specialized variant of Kiroshi’s T.O.P., the fittingly nicknamed ‘A-TOP’ has superior optics and proprietary flight guidance software.

SP12 Head Armor with no Armor Penalty. Has built-in Anti-Smog Breathing Mask, Flashlight, Radio Communicator, and TUp (+1 Slot) Smart Glasses (w/ Anti-Dazzle, Image Enhance, and TeleOptics). The helmet’s visor may be raised or lowered without an Action. While lowered, the user’s face is completely obscured and they gain access to cybereye options installed into the Smart Glasses. While worn (and with the visor lowered) by a user with Pilot Air Vehicle Skill Level 7 or higher, or Moto Rank 2 or higher, this helmet’s custom software provides a +2 bonus to Pilot Air Vehicle Skill Checks.

Covers: Head
SP: 12
Armor Penalty: none

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
Heavier version of an Armorjack. -2 to REF, DEX, and MOVE.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

“FUCK ARMOR PENALTIES.” — Anonymous Lizard

SP 16 or lower Body/Head Armor Enhancement. Cannot be installed in any form of Metalgear. All of the armor’s Armor Penalties (if any), are reduced by 1 (Minimum 0). Armor with this enhancement cannot be combined with a kit or tech upgraded to resemble any form of Fashion it does not already appear as by default. This enhancement cannot be Tech Upgraded to further reduce Armor Penalties.

Type: Armor Enhancement (Body/Head, SP 16 or lower, not Metalgear)
Attachment slots: 0

Foundry notes:

  • Armor Enhancement rules: one Enhancement per piece of armor (armor worn on both body and head counts as one piece); not for cyberware armor (Skinweave, Subdermal Armor) or armor that's part of an ACPA or vehicle; SP limits use the armor's fully repaired SP; a Tech installs or removes one in 1 hour with no check; they don't count as Tech Upgrades for Upgrade Expertise. Armor Attachments have no limit per armor unless stated.
  • All of the armor's Armor Penalties drop by 1 (minimum 0); lower its penalty by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Enhancements & Kits).

Injecting a target with Speedheal immediately causes them to heal HP equal to their BODY plus their WILL. This effect does not work on Mortally Wounded targets, and can only be used on a target once per day.

Using a nanobot liquid solution pre-programmed to attack damaged tissue, musculature, and bone, this revolutionary medicine can turn a lost cause into a hopeful survivor. So, take a deep breath... and get back in the game.

Pharmaceutical. When administered, the recipient immediately heals 5 HP. For the next 9 Seconds (3 Rounds), they do not suffer damage from any currently-afflicted Critical Injuries (effects and/or penalties still apply). Any new Critical Injuries sustained while Bounce Back is active still deal their initial Bonus Damage. While Bounce Back is active, anyone that attempts to Stabilize and/or Quick Fix the recipient gains a +2 bonus to their Check, and the time to apply a Quick Fix is reduced to a single Action. A person can only benefit from two uses of Bounce Back per day, but cannot benefit from another dose if they are still under the effects of Bounce Back.

Cost: Medtech-made Pharmaceutical (no market price listed)
Type: Pharmaceutical

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > Consumables > Pharmaceuticals).
